YOU NEED TO SIGN UP FIRST TO JOIN!
Click the link at the top of this page. 
Only in this way your reward can be recorded!
-Go live for at least 20 mins is required 🕘
-Only invited top tier hosts are eligible☑️

Top Tier hosts, this is your chance to shine!
Go Live now and unlock Beans Back 🔥🔥🔥

📅 Event run dates: 
First Round: 1.3-1.4
Second Round: 1.10-1.11
Third Round: 1.17-1.18
Fourth Round: 1.24 -1.25
Who can join this round (1.3 - 1.4): Nov. A Tier & above
⏰ Event run time: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM AEDT

lv.1 - if 1,000 beans recevied, get 300 beans reward

lv.2 - if 2,000 beans received, get extra 300 beans reward

lv.3 - if 3,000 beans received, get extra 350 beans reward

lv.4 - if 5,000 beans received, get extra 650 beans reward

lv.5 - if 8,000 beans received, get extra 1,000 beans reward

lv.6 - if 11,000 beans received, get extra 1,050 beans reward

lv.7 - if 15,000 beans received, get extra 1,350 beans reward

lv.8 - if 20,000 beans received, get extra 2,000 beans reward

lv.9 - if 28,000 beans received, get extra 3,000 beans reward

lv.10 - if 38,000 beans received, get extra 4,000 beans reward

The maximum reward you can receive is 14,000 beans
💃 Go live in Solo or Multiguest Room as a host at least 20 mins within the hour, and you can do all event formats you like!
